headline: Staff-Level Design Program Leader
summary: Design and production leader with 10+ years across big tech, startups, and culture. I've produced flagship moments for Google I/O and Meta Connect and built artist-first programs at Red Bull Music Academy and the MIT Media Lab. Today I lead brand design for Reality Labs Wearables, building first-party brands from scratch (Meta Glasses, Muse Charm) and leading partner brand work with EssilorLuxottica (Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta). I'm at my best when the brief is undefined and the stakes are high.

experience.orgNote: Division behind Meta's AI glasses, wearables, and the Horizon platform.
bullets: Lead brand design operations for Meta's Wearables portfolio (4+ brands in market, 94% category share, +263% Y/Y growth). Own planning, resourcing, budget, cross-functional partnerships, and leadership reviews, directing a 10+ person multidisciplinary studio and agency partners against a fast-moving hardware roadmap.

Led the end-to-end creative program for Meta Connect 2025 (31+ people, 8+ workstreams). Built the governance model and cross-functional workflows, and delivered a new visual system and six films for the CEO keynote in under three weeks. Grew social reach 4x to 190M and livestream views 50% to 62M.
Launched first-party brands from scratch (Meta Glasses, Muse Charm) and led 0-to-1 partner brands with EssilorLuxottica (Oakley Meta, Meta Ray-Ban Display) from brand strategy through global launch.

Led creative for the Horizon Store, part of Reality Labs' most profitable business. Built a studio model with Product Design that shaped store UI and scaled to 250+ monetization campaigns a year, beating the revenue goal by 71% and halving agency costs.

Founded an in-house AI design lab to educate the team on generative tools, with a physical space in LA, hands-on workshops on AI in design practice, and an artist speaker series run with the creator team.

experience.orgNote: VR and mixed reality division behind Horizon Venues.
bullets: Shipped the 0-to-1 live production pipeline for Horizon Venues, launching at Connect 2020 with tentpole shows from Steve Aoki, Major Lazer, and a TIDAL music series that drove a 25% lift in subscriptions and 8x weekly time spent in app.

experience.orgNote: Events & Experiences team behind I/O, Made by Google, YouTube activations, and Cloud Next.
bullets: Turned product stories into physical experiences for 10K+ attendees across Google I/O, Made by Google Hardware Launch, Cloud Next London, and Zeitgeist.
Produced keynote demos, including the live Stadia launch at GDC 2019, and 100+ partner experiences for the THEA Award-winning Google Assistant Ride at CES 2019.
Led technical production and procurement for a $5M+ global hardware inventory, from central warehouse to on-site distribution for global activations.

experience.orgNote: Early-stage startup building biometric wearables for live entertainment.
bullets: Led activations at SXSW, the NCAA Men's Final Four, and Wimbledon for 20th Century Fox, Pepsi, Degree, and iHeartMedia. Managed $2M+ budgets; campaigns earned 40+ press features and 3.6M+ views.

experience.orgNote: Arts and technology festival at the MIT Media Lab.
bullets: Architected a festival for 750+ attendees. Grew attendance 50% and budget 75% with partners like Adobe, Google, and Sonos; featured in MIT News and The Atlantic.

experience.orgNote: Culture marketing across Red Bull Music Academy, Records, and Sound Select.
bullets: Established Red Bull's first collegiate music pipeline, connecting Red Bull Music Academy, Sound Select, and Red Bull Records with the 18-24 demographic through campus activations and the first Berklee cohort at Red Bull Studios New York, driving brand impressions and campus engagement.

education.detail: B.M., Music Business/Management; Fellow, Berklee Institute of Creative Entrepreneurship
Cross-registered student and TA, Program in Art, Science and Technology
